description: Test suite for CLI commands in the 'cli' package, testing various command functions such as list, stop, config, add, MCP, VC, version, uninstall, logs, init, and framework commands like install, run, dev, including flag parsing and configuration handling.

methods.name: TestListCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'list' CLI command for correct execution without errors.

methods.name: TestStopCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'stop' CLI command for argument validation and error handling.

methods.name: TestConfigCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'config' CLI command for correct execution.

methods.name: TestAddCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'add' CLI command for argument validation.

methods.name: TestMCPCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'MCP' CLI command for correct execution.

methods.name: TestVCCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'VC' CLI command for correct execution.

methods.name: TestVersionCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'version' CLI command with version info.

methods.name: TestUninstallCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'uninstall' CLI command for argument validation.

methods.name: TestLogsCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'logs' CLI command for argument validation.

methods.name: TestRootCommandFlags
methods.description: Tests various flags (--verbose, --port, --storage-mode) on the root command.

methods.name: TestRootCommandInvalidArgs
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid command arguments.

methods.name: TestRootCommandConfigFile
methods.description: Tests configuration file handling via '--config' flag.

methods.name: TestFrameworkCommands
methods.description: Verifies existence of framework commands (install, run, dev) in the CLI.
